description: This Java class implements a TransactionFactory that retrieves transaction and user transaction objects from JNDI for the OFBiz framework. It manages JNDI lookups for transaction manager and user transaction, and provides methods to obtain database connections through JNDI data sources, including handling XA data sources.

classes.name: JNDITransactionFactory
classes.description: Implements transaction management using JNDI for lookup of TransactionManager, UserTransaction, and database DataSources, supporting both XA and non-XA sources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getTransactionManager
methods.description: Retrieves the TransactionManager instance from JNDI, caching for reuse.

methods.name: getUserTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the UserTransaction instance from JNDI, caching for reuse.

methods.name: getTxMgrName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this TransactionFactory implementation.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Obtains a database connection based on the helper info, either via JNDI DataSource or inline JDBC.

methods.name: getJndiConnection
methods.description: Performs JNDI lookup for a DataSource, handles XADataSource if applicable, and returns a connection, with caching.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs any necessary cleanup; present but empty in this implementation.
